description: Logically isolated virtual network for hosting AWS cloud resources.

sections.title: Network Addressing
sections.description: Primary IPv4 block and tenancy configuration

fields.label: IPv4 CIDR Block

validation.error_message: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28 prefix length.

fields.why: Defines the total available private IP address range for subnets inside this VPC.
fields.impact: Cannot be modified directly; changing the primary CIDR block recreates the entire VPC and all nested resources.

fields.label: Instance Tenancy
fields.why: Determines whether EC2 instances launched into this VPC run on single-tenant physical hardware.
fields.impact: Dedicated tenancy incurs significant additional hardware hosting costs across all launched EC2 instances.

sections.title: DNS Configuration
sections.description: Internal DNS lookup and hostname resolution settings

fields.label: Enable DNS Resolution
fields.why: Enables resolution of public/private DNS hostnames via Amazon-provided Route 53 DNS server.
fields.impact: Required for AWS PrivateLink endpoints, Route 53 Private Zones, and public hostname resolution.

fields.label: Enable DNS Hostnames
fields.why: Assigns automatic public DNS hostnames to EC2 instances assigned public IP addresses.
fields.impact: Disabling prevents EC2 instances from acquiring public DNS names upon launch.
